data.description: Modern Living at Luma Park Views
data.display_address: Luma Park Views, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Luma Park Views in Jumeirah Village Circle presents a collection of premium 1-3 bedroom apartments designed for those who appreciate quality and comfort. The building's sleek, modern design incorporates high-end materials that offer both durability and beauty. With multiple floors, including a podium area and residential levels, Luma Park Views offers a diverse range of apartment options that cater to the most discerning tastes.

In addition to the luxurious residences, Luma Park Views features a comprehensive suite of amenities. Residents can relax by the two swimming pools, stay fit in the fully equipped gyms, or enjoy the tranquility of the internal garden. The property also includes a jogging track and a play area for children, ensuring there is something for everyone. The stunning views of the lush parks and green spaces only add to the allure of this exceptional community.
